Title: Lily + Figma — Lily Design System

Description: Babu ɗakin karatu ko plugin na Lily Figma da ake kulawa da shi. Alamomin ƙira na jigogin tunani 63 an wallafa su a tsarin DTCG kuma ana iya shigo da su Figma a yau da plugin na al'umma da ke akwai.

# Babu ɗakin karatu na Figma da ake kulawa da shi — ga abin da ke akwai maimakon haka

Wannan shafin ya kasance yana cewa "ana zuwa nan ba da jimawa ba." Ba ya cewa haka yanzu, domin babu wanda yake gina shi. Ga halin da ake ciki na gaskiya, da hanyar gaske da ke aiki a yau.

## Abin da babu

Babu ɗakin karatun abubuwan Lily na hukuma a Figma, kuma babu plugin na Figma da ake kulawa da shi. Gina da kula da ɗakin karatu na kayan aikin ƙira da kyau alƙawari ne na gaske kuma mai ci gaba — tsarin abubuwan Figma, sunayen bambance-bambance, auto-layout, bututun wallafawa na kansa — dabam da kula da lamba, kuma wannan aikin bai ɗauke shi ba.

## Abin da ke akwai a yau

Kowanne daga cikin jigogin tunani 63 yana da tushen alamomin ƙira — launi, radius, girma, iyaka — da aka wallafa a [tsarin DTCG 2025.10](https://www.w3.org/community/design-tokens/2025/10/28/design-tokens-specification-reaches-first-stable-version/) a [`themes/tokens/*.json`](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/tree/main/themes/tokens). Wannan tsarin shi ne ainihin abin da kayan aikin alamomi na zamani ke karantawa. Za ka iya jan palette na jigon Lily zuwa Figma da kanka, yanzu, ba tare da plugin daga wannan aikin ba:

1. Shigar da plugin na al'umma [Tokens Studio for Figma](https://tokens.studio/) (ko shigowa ta Variables ta Figma da kanta, inda tsarinka ke goyon bayan shigo da DTCG).
2. Shigo da `themes/tokens/{theme-slug}.json` ga jigon da kake so — misali `united-kingdom-national-health-service-england-for-patients.json`.
3. Tokens Studio yana ƙirƙirar masu canji na Figma daga ƙimar DTCG, waɗanda za ka iya amfani da su ga abubuwanka na kanka.

Wannan yana ba ka alamomin launi da siffa na Lily a Figma. Ba ya ba ka ainihin abubuwan Lily a matsayin abubuwan Figma — babu wanda ya gina hakan, kuma wannan shafin ba zai yi kamar akasin haka ba.

## Ana shirin ainihin ɗakin karatu na Figma?

A yanzu a'a, kuma alƙawarinsa ba kyauta ba ne: duba [RFC 6](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/RFC.md#rfc-6-is-45-reference-themes-useful-or-should-this-be-a-token-system) don tambayar da ke buɗe da abin da zai sauya tunanin aikin — mafi amfani shi ne mai ƙira ya faɗi musamman abin da yake buƙata daga wannan layin. Idan kai ne, [gaya mana](mailto:joel@joelparkerhenderson.com) ko buɗe issue.
